welcome: Clearer party information and map controls.

sections.title: Player Maps
items: Cluster tooltips group players from the same known party inside a rounded white border, with a party icon. A player whose teammates are outside the cluster still shows the party indicator.
The world-map QT button stays fully visible and shows a red X when QT markers are hidden.
Hovering the QT button no longer dims the map while QT markers are hidden.
